about: 2021 Census GCP G01/G07/G09F/G09G/G09H/G14/G32/G37/G49B/G60B SA1 tables, pooled to Western Australia's 59 Legislative Assembly districts for the frame's election date. Each SA1 counts whole to the district its polygon centroid lies in (boundary SA1s are not split; the state total is never moved). Bases match the federal and other-state stores (ex-not-stated; see the qld frame stores for the full per-lane specification). The industry picker (ind, key order in indKeys) reads the edition's industry-of-employment nineteen ANZSIC-2006 divisions, each shared over the divisions' own summed counts. p is census persons; n the SA1 count. The four WA sentinel SA1s (migratory/offshore/no-usual-address) carry no polygon and sit outside the join, holding 8572 persons statewide.
